:::

<p><code>action</code> carries the human-readable narrative shown by the <code>print()</code> methods.
<code>value</code> is lower-cased and passed through <code>make_action_cli()</code> on assignment,
which stores a named logical vector saying which of the five standard steps
(aggregate, shift, compare, proportion of total, count distinct) the
calculation performs. <code>print_actions_steps()</code> draws the checklist from it.
</p>

## Usage

```r
action(value = NULL, method = NA_character_)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-value"><code>value</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-value"></a></dt>
<dd><p>The steps the calculation performs, e.g.
<code>c("aggregate", "shift")</code>. Stored as a named logical vector.</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-method"><code>method</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-method"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A string describing the method used by the calculation.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>An <code>action</code> S7 object.
</p>
